- New `vd login LINK`: log in once in the app's own browser window; afterwards downloads use the login automatically, so a plain `vd "LINK"` is enough (works with Brave/Chrome on Windows too)
- New `vd logout` to delete the saved login, and `--no-saved-login` to skip it once
- GUI: "Einloggen…" button next to "Browser-Login"; "Automatisch (gespeicherter Login)" is the default
